description: Employee id and expense amount parsed out of a free-text question. Cases marked known_gap record parsing the code gets wrong today; they are reported but do not fail the gate.

cases.question: Can E101 claim 750 for a client dinner?
Is approval needed for a $500 expense by E103?
Does E104 need approval for travel?
What is the expense reimbursement policy?
Claim 1200 for employee E101, countersigned by E104.
cases.note: The first id wins; the workflow only looks up the claimant.

cases.question: E101 submitted a claim from 2024 for 300 dollars.
cases.note: Any bare number is taken as the amount, so the year wins and the wrong approval rule is applied.

cases.question: E101 needs approval for an expense of five hundred dollars.
cases.note: Spelled-out amounts are not parsed; the workflow routes to recovery instead of applying the policy.

cases.question: E103 wants to claim 0 for a free event.
cases.note: Only amounts above zero are accepted, so a zero claim looks like a missing amount.
